text: Aree ka makko, wi'anon mo: "Menen ko men Nulaaɓe Joomi maaɗa -an Fir'awna- accidu men e ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila ɓen, wata a leptir ɓe warugol ɓiɗɓe maɓɓe worɓe ɓen, e hersinngol rewɓe maɓɓe ɓen, gomɗii men addanii ma dalil e goongugol amen immorde ka Joomi maaɗa, hoolaare nden e Lepte Alla ɗen ko gomɗinɗo jokki Peewal Alla ngal woo ɗum woodani.
